rep.angle: lead with a peer company's result
rep.name: Dev

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hi Priya, Dev at HyperSale. A freight brokerage we support spots coaching gaps weekly instead of at quota time; could I take four minutes?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: You’ve got four minutes. How are you spotting those coaching gaps?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: We run reps through realistic AI buyer roleplays, then score each skill with the exact quote as evidence. How are you measuring coaching progress today?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Mostly manager ride-alongs and whether the numbers improve afterward. We already do ride-alongs, so what would this tell me that they don’t?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Ride-alongs give a snapshot; HyperSale gives consistent weekly data across all 60 reps, tied to exact language. Which skills are managers struggling to assess?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Whether feedback actually sticks week to week—who changes behavior after coaching and who doesn’t. But we bought Gong and nobody used it, so why would reps do these roleplays?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Fair concern. Unlike reviewing Gong calls, reps complete one short scenario weekly and managers see whether coached behaviors change; what blocked Gong adoption?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Managers didn’t build it into the coaching cadence, and reps saw it as surveillance, so usage died after a month. Why wouldn’t this go the same way?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: It could, unless managers own the cadence and reps see it as practice, not monitoring. Would a 30-day pilot with one team be worth testing?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Maybe. What does the 30-day pilot cost?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: It depends on pilot team size; standard pricing is $90 per rep monthly on an annual plan. How many reps would you include?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Ten reps. What’s the all-in cost for 30 days?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: For ten reps, I’d scope it at $900 all-in for 30 days. If that’s workable, I can send a one-page pilot outline.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Nine hundred’s workable. Send the one-pager, and include exactly what managers and reps have to do each week and how you’ll measure whether coaching sticks.
